# PHO Sengeafsnit Regionspsykiatri Horsens

PHO Sengeafsnit Regionspsykiatri Horsens is a clinical department (a "sengeafsnit", or inpatient ward, under the "PHO" designation) at Regionspsykiatri Horsens, appearing in the Danish ADHD-databasen 2024 annual report as one of the treatment units reported on in relation to national quality indicators for ADHD care [^src1][^src2]. The unit stands out in the data as achieving 100 % fulfillment of Indicator 10 [^src1], but this figure rests on a very limited data foundation, meaning the result should be interpreted with caution rather than taken as representative performance [^src1].

Indicator 10 measures, across the ADHD database, the proportion of adult treatment courses in which a patient's need for social support was assessed no later than 120 days after treatment start — a measure reported for the first time in the 2024 report [^src1]. Nationally the fulfillment rate for this indicator was only 37 %, against a quality target of 90 %, with regional rates ranging from 14 % to 52 % [^src1]. Against that backdrop of widespread underperformance, PHO Sengeafsnit Regionspsykiatri Horsens' reported 100 % score (based on a range of 3–100 in the underlying figures) is a striking outlier, and the steering group behind the database explicitly discussed causes for the generally low fulfillment rates, including registration practices and the data foundation from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, before deciding to work on improving registration practices [^src1].

The unit is also mentioned in a second context in the report, where a figure of 0 (with a range of 0–98) is recorded for it [^src2]. This appears alongside the report's separate presentation of Indicator 11, which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which the patient was in treatment with ADHD medication within 120 days of the start of a care pathway — the first time this indicator was compiled for adults, following the 2024 expansion of the ADHD database to include adult patients [^src2]. The national picture for Indicator 11 showed considerable regional variation, from 85 % in Region Nordjylland to 37 % in Region Hovedstaden, a spread the report attributes more likely to registration difficulties than to real clinical differences [^src2].

Taken together, the two figures for PHO Sengeafsnit Regionspsykiatri Horsens — a headline 100 % on Indicator 10 and a 0 (0–98) figure elsewhere — illustrate the broader theme running through the ADHD-databasen 2024 report: newly introduced indicators are producing highly uneven and sometimes unreliable results across Danish psychiatric units, driven at least in part by inconsistent registration practices rather than genuine differences in care quality [^src1][^src2].
